reason: It's only in English. My stylists won't use an English app to bill customers in front of them, so I'd pay ₹10,000 and still be writing in the register. And another ₹500 every month on top of that, for something they might not even use.
objection: English only. If my staff can't comfortably use it in Odia or Hindi, the whole thing is wasted money, and I don't want another monthly payment.
would_change_my_mind: An Odia or Hindi version my stylists can use without help, with the monthly fee dropped or turned into one yearly payment at a discount.
